title: Plan a trip with friends
intro: We will find the week when three calendars line up and start a group chat to plan the trip.

steps.say: This is a dashboard with made-up data. Nothing is sent. We open the Agenda tab.
Your calendar and two friends' calendars all show the same free week: week 3.
A group message is already written. Add a line by voice.
act: I can drive if we pick somewhere close.

steps.say: The demo says no group chat was started. In the real dashboard, nothing happens until you press the button.
That is the whole workflow. Press Replay to watch it again.
